title: Credit cards grow but lose share
estimate: Credit +27.1% a year [95% CI +22.0%, +32.4%]; P2M minus credit +0.222 log points a year [95% CI +0.033, +0.411]
consistency: Credit growth positive in 39 of 39 months; P2M faster in 38 of 39
test: Two parts: mean Δ12 ln(credit) > 0, and mean [Δ12 ln(P2M) − Δ12 ln(credit)] > 0. Mean 12-month log change, Newey-West (12-lag) standard errors, 39 matched months Jan 2023–Mar 2026.
data: RBI Payment System Indicators: domestic debit/credit card purchases; NPCI UPI ecosystem statistics: P2P/P2M

estimate: sup-F = 62.2 at 2024-07; trend +15.4% a year before, -12.8% after
